Problem Statement:
You are given an integer N. Write a program to print each digit of the number separated by a space on a single line. 
Input Description:
A single integer N (0 ≤ N ≤ 1000000) 
Output Description:
Print the digits of the number separated by a space. 
Sample Input:
348 
Sample Output:
3 4 8
